blocks.lead: Phiora is two tables — kinds and items — and everything else is a filter or a relation.

sections.title: The model
sections.body: Every app, user, club, token, look and PFT is an item tagged with its kind. Lists are filters over items.

sections.title: The API
sections.body: List kinds, filter items on any attribute, fetch relations, return the full tree, and run saved filters.

sections.title: Writes & storage
sections.body: Writes go to local disk, Azure Blob or S3. Deployments for Container Apps and App Runner are included.

items.a: Kinds and items keep the model simple and extensible — new features add a kind, not a table.
Any field ending in Id or Ids becomes an edge between items.
